build_flashqwen3_model: build a FlashQwen3 model from a model path for text embedding inference with configurable pooling
embed_batch: embed a FlashBatch or PaddedBatch using FlashQwen3 to produce a list of Embedding objects
load_weight_safetensors: load a weight tensor from a safetensors file by name using a weight map and target device
apply_rotary_pos_emb: apply rotary positional embeddings to query and key tensors using cos and sin values
compute_rope_parameters: compute default rotary positional embedding parameters from a Qwen3Config including inverse frequencies
